summary: A schedule from BBN for adding more core memory to every IMP and TIP, the network's packet-switching machines, during early 1973. It lists the planned memory sizes after the upgrade and warns that TIPs would need more floor space. It was replaced by RFC 447.

plainLanguage.summary: RFC 434 lists planned dates for adding memory to ARPANET IMP and TIP machines. It warns that the work could keep machines down longer than their usual maintenance period.

questions: what memory sizes were planned for imp and tip machines
when were the imp tip retrofits scheduled
subtitle: A preliminary schedule for adding core memory to IMPs and TIPs.

tldr.problem: BBN planned to retrofit IMP and TIP machines with more core memory, requiring scheduled maintenance and sometimes longer downtime.
tldr.mechanism: The RFC lists a preliminary site-by-site retrofit schedule and aligns the work with each site's usual monthly preventive maintenance where possible.
tldr.outcome: RFC 434 is a preliminary maintenance schedule and was obsoleted by RFC 447.

today: RFC 434 is a preliminary IMP/TIP maintenance schedule and was obsoleted by RFC 447.

sections.title: Memory After the Retrofit
sections.content:
BBN planned to retrofit each IMP and TIP with additional core memory during the first several months of 1973. The listed final memory sizes were 16K words for an IMP, 28K words for a TIP, and 32K words for a TIP with the magnetic tape option.

The expanded TIP memory would require the TIP to occupy two cabinets.
sections.plainLanguage: The upgrade planned different memory sizes for IMPs and TIPs. TIPs would need two cabinets after their memory expansion.

sections.title: Site-by-Site Maintenance Dates
sections.content:
The RFC provides a preliminary list of retrofit dates from January through April. For example, Xerox was scheduled for 1/3, MIT for 1/8, Utah for 2/1, UCLA for 3/19, and Illinois for 4/18.

BBN arranged the schedule to coincide with usual monthly preventive maintenance where possible. The RFC warns that the machines would often be down longer than during normal maintenance, and says the schedule could be updated by later RFCs.
sections.plainLanguage: Each site received a planned maintenance date. The work was coordinated with usual maintenance when possible, but could cause longer outages.

sections.title: Space and Rescheduling
sections.content: Sites that expected difficulty making room for an expanded TIP were asked to contact Hawley Rising at BBN. The schedule gives dates as month and day and presents itself as preliminary.
sections.plainLanguage: Sites that needed more room for a TIP were asked to contact BBN. The dates were preliminary and could be updated.
